problem_text:
A city planner needs to allocate a fixed budget across 16 different infrastructure projects to maximize the total projected benefit score.
The profile for each project is as follows:
* Project A: benefit score 0.066, impact factor 0.130, allocation bounds [0.041, 0.891]
* Project B: benefit score 0.041, impact factor 0.104, allocation bounds [0.023, 0.769]
* Project C: benefit score 0.038, impact factor 0.119, allocation bounds [0.089, 0.623]
* Project D: benefit score 0.050, impact factor 0.250, allocation bounds [0.027, 0.554]
* Project E: benefit score 0.046, impact factor 0.045, allocation bounds [0.096, 0.847]
* Project F: benefit score 0.066, impact factor 0.069, allocation bounds [0.068, 0.571]
* Project G: benefit score 0.036, impact factor 0.228, allocation bounds [0.025, 0.301]
* Project H: benefit score 0.075, impact factor 0.180, allocation bounds [0.055, 0.579]
* Project I: benefit score 0.093, impact factor 0.153, allocation bounds [0.079, 0.798]
* Project J: benefit score 0.050, impact factor 0.228, allocation bounds [0.030, 0.474]
* Project K: benefit score 0.131, impact factor 0.122, allocation bounds [0.041, 0.883]
* Project L: benefit score 0.079, impact factor 0.043, allocation bounds [0.008, 0.300]
* Project M: benefit score 0.025, impact factor 0.028, allocation bounds [0.064, 0.860]
* Project N: benefit score 0.031, impact factor 0.145, allocation bounds [0.020, 0.589]
* Project O: benefit score 0.090, impact factor 0.128, allocation bounds [0.097, 0.659]
* Project P: benefit score 0.078, impact factor 0.150, allocation bounds [0.037, 0.804]
Each project must receive a fraction of the total budget within its specified bounds, and the sum of all budget fractions must equal one. To ensure timely completion, the group of quick-delivery projects, represented by the subset Q = {B, C, D, E, F, G, H, K, L, M, N, O, P}, must collectively receive at least 0.650 of the total budget. Furthermore, the overall community disruption, measured by a composite impact index, must not exceed 0.127, and the total projected benefit score must be at least 0.050.
Find the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total benefit score while satisfying all constraints.
